summary: P3: the doc comment of `pooled` says the pool 'costs the same CPU time'. That is wrong. On forca-canon-595ded99 (14 vCPU, load 4-6), I alternated three runs of the schema_doc binary at d7518d159 and at 24b8194a6. Median wall fell 38.4 -> 13.3 s. Median CPU rose 54.0 -> 92.7 s: user 48 -> 76 s, sys 6 -> 18 s. The work is the same, about 270 to 276 canon schema starts; each start costs more while six run at once. Keep the pool: cargo test runs the binaries one after another, CI pays for wall time, and the CHANGELOG already says there is no CPU saving. Fix: say that the pool shortens the wall time and costs more CPU time when cores are busy.
